name: Transfer and insurance duty
what: Pay duty on transfers of land and other dutiable property, and on general insurance premiums (collected by insurers), under each state's duties law.

coverage.note: Every business that buys land or dutiable property, or insures a risk.

consistency_note: Each state and territory has its own duties law, with its own rates, thresholds and concessions.

basis.quote: 17 Who is liable to pay transfer duty (1) Transfer duty imposed on a statutory dutiable transaction must be paid by the statutory entity under the transaction. (2) Transfer duty imposed on another dutiable transaction must be paid by the parties to the transaction.
235 Who is liable to pay the duty? The general insurer is liable to pay the duty, except as provided by section 236.

20. Who is liable to pay duty The person liable to pay duty chargeable on a dutiable transaction described in Schedule 1 column 2 is the person described opposite that transaction in Schedule 1 column 4, unless another person is required under this Chapter to pay the duty.
